question: GQ-006
subject: the eighth deferral — "disable_content_logging is an observability trade only Shaan can weigh"
how_i_framed_it: A binary: leave bodies stored and keep losing ~2.92 MB per request, or disable content logging gateway-wide and lose the ability to inspect ANY request body, including for debugging the traffic that is filling the disk.

what_i_found.reading: Bifrost exposes PER-REQUEST override flags, both currently off. If enabled, a client can opt out of body storage on its own requests — which is not the binary I described.

the_third_option: Enable allow_per_request_content_storage_override, then have THIS AGENT opt out on its own calls. Shaan keeps full body inspection for every other client; the 91% of disk growth that is mine stops being written. The trade I presented as unavoidable may not be a trade at all.
what_i_have_not_verified: Whether the shim can set whatever header or field the override reads, and what that field is called. The flags exist; the client-side mechanism is untested. This is a lead, not a solution, and I am recording it as such rather than adding it to the escalation as fact.
correction: "Only Shaan can weigh this" was true of the gateway-wide flag and skipped a middle option sitting in the same config table. Eighth deferral, eighth narrowing.
